title: Admirable · adj
subtitle: 「值得尊敬的／值得稱讚的」，究竟是哪一種 admirable？
description: 「值得尊敬的／值得稱讚的」，究竟是哪一種 admirable？

words.meaning: 值得尊敬的；令人敬佩的
words.note: 最直接、最透明的近義說法之一。當 admirable 指某人的品格、行為、態度或成就值得別人尊敬時很自然。
words.example: Her willingness to admit the mistake was worthy of respect.
words.exampleZh: 她願意承認錯誤，這一點值得尊敬。

exercises.original: Her decision to admit the mistake publicly was admirable.
exercises.zh: 她公開承認錯誤的決定令人敬佩。
exercises.upgrade: worthy of respect · 值得尊敬的；令人敬佩的

options.explanation: popular = 公開認錯未必令她更受歡迎。
successful = 句子不是在評價她是否達成目標。
worthy of respect = 願意公開承認錯誤是一種值得尊敬的行為，因此 worthy of respect 很自然。
pleasant = 公開承認錯誤未必是令人愉快的事。

exercises.original: The way he treated junior staff was admirable.
exercises.zh: 他對待初級員工的方式令人尊敬。
exercises.upgrade: worthy of respect · 值得尊敬的；令人敬佩的

options.explanation: pleasant = 態度可能 pleasant，但原句評價的是品格。
successful = 不合人際行為評價。
worthy of respect = 對較弱勢同事的待人方式值得尊敬，這個片語最貼切。
excellent = 可以稱 excellent behaviour，但不如 worthy of respect 直接表達敬佩。

exercises.original: Her refusal to take credit for other people's work was admirable.
exercises.zh: 她拒絕把別人的功勞據為己有，令人敬佩。
exercises.upgrade: worthy of respect · 值得尊敬的；令人敬佩的

options.explanation: worthy of respect = 不搶別人的功勞反映品格，因此 worthy of respect 很精確。

words.note: 當 admirable 指某個行為、努力、決定或品質值得公開稱讚時很精確；比 impressive 更帶明確正面評價。
words.example: The volunteers made a praiseworthy effort to support local families.
words.exampleZh: 義工為支援本地家庭付出的努力值得稱讚。

exercises.original: The team's effort to reduce waste was admirable.
exercises.zh: 團隊減少浪費的努力值得稱讚。
exercises.upgrade: praiseworthy · 值得稱讚的；可嘉的

options.explanation: successful = 即使最終成效有限，努力本身仍可值得稱讚。
popular = 是否受歡迎不是重點。
praiseworthy = 對一項正面努力作明確稱讚時，praiseworthy 最自然。

exercises.original: Her honesty during the investigation was admirable.
exercises.zh: 她在調查期間的誠實表現值得稱讚。
exercises.upgrade: praiseworthy · 值得稱讚的；可嘉的

options.explanation: excellent = 誠實可以 excellent，但這裡更直接是價值上的稱讚。
popular = 誠實未必討好所有人。
praiseworthy = 誠實是一種值得稱讚的品質，praiseworthy 很精確。

exercises.original: The decision to refund customers immediately was admirable.
exercises.zh: 立即向顧客退款的決定值得稱讚。
exercises.upgrade: praiseworthy · 值得稱讚的；可嘉的

options.explanation: successful = 退款決定不是是否成功的問題。
popular = 可能受歡迎，但句子在做價值評價。
praiseworthy = 對公司主動作出負責任決定表示讚許，praiseworthy 很自然。

words.note: 較正式，常用於評價努力、誠實、勇氣、紀律或決定，表示值得認可和讚許。
words.example: Her patience throughout the long negotiation was commendable.
words.exampleZh: 她在漫長談判中表現出的耐性值得嘉許。

exercises.original: Her patience during the long complaint process was admirable.
exercises.zh: 她在漫長投訴處理過程中的耐性值得嘉許。
exercises.upgrade: commendable · 值得嘉許的；可嘉的

options.explanation: popular = 耐性不等於受歡迎。
successful = 不是結果是否成功。
pleasant = 耐性是一種品質，不只是令人舒服。
commendable = 正式肯定某人持續展現的正面品質，commendable 很合適。

exercises.original: The students showed admirable discipline throughout the trip.
exercises.zh: 學生在整趟旅程中展現出值得嘉許的紀律。
exercises.upgrade: commendable · 值得嘉許的；可嘉的

options.explanation: respectful = 有禮貌只是紀律的一部分。
excellent = 可以形容程度高，但 commendable 更表示值得肯定。
commendable = 對紀律表現作正式正面評價，commendable 是典型搭配。

exercises.original: His willingness to listen to criticism was admirable.
exercises.zh: 他願意聽取批評，這點值得嘉許。
exercises.upgrade: commendable · 值得嘉許的；可嘉的

options.explanation: commendable = 願意接受批評是一項值得肯定的態度，最適合 commendable。
successful = 是否成功聽取不是核心。

words.meaning: 值得讚揚的；值得稱許的
words.note: 較正式、較書面，常形容目標、原則、努力或意圖本身值得讚賞；語氣比 praiseworthy 更書面。
words.example: The plan has the laudable aim of reducing food waste.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃以減少食物浪費為目標，值得讚揚。

exercises.original: The programme has the admirable aim of making public spaces more accessible.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃以提升公共空間可及性為目標，值得讚揚。
exercises.upgrade: laudable · 值得讚揚的；值得稱許的

options.explanation: successful = 這裡評價的是 aim，不是成果。
popular = 目標是否受歡迎不是核心。
laudable = laudable aim 是很自然的書面搭配，表示目標本身值得讚賞。

exercises.original: Their admirable intention was to protect small local businesses.
exercises.zh: 他們保護本地小商戶的意圖值得稱許。
exercises.upgrade: laudable · 值得讚揚的；值得稱許的

options.explanation: laudable = 較正式地稱讚 intention 本身，laudable 最精確。
excellent = 可以稱 excellent intention，但較少見，也不如 laudable 書面自然。

exercises.original: The charity's admirable goal is to provide free legal advice.
exercises.zh: 這個慈善機構提供免費法律意見的目標值得讚揚。
exercises.upgrade: laudable · 值得讚揚的；值得稱許的

options.explanation: laudable = 對具有公共利益的目標作書面稱讚，laudable 很自然。
popular = 是否受歡迎不是重點。

words.note: 當 admirable 指某人的行為、服務、紀律或表現好到可以成為別人的榜樣時最自然；比 commendable 更強。
words.example: The nurse showed exemplary professionalism during the emergency.
words.exampleZh: 這名護士在緊急情況中展現出堪作榜樣的專業精神。

exercises.original: The firefighter showed admirable courage during the rescue.
exercises.zh: 消防員在救援中展現出堪作榜樣的勇氣。
exercises.upgrade: exemplary · 堪作榜樣的；模範的

options.explanation: exemplary = 勇氣表現高到可作典範，exemplary 最貼切。
famous = 勇氣和知名度無關。
successful = 即使救援成功，句子仍在評價勇氣品質。

exercises.original: Her record of public service has been admirable.
exercises.zh: 她的公共服務紀錄堪作榜樣。
exercises.upgrade: exemplary · 堪作榜樣的；模範的

options.explanation: excellent = 接近，但 exemplary 更進一步表示足以成為榜樣。
exemplary = 長期公共服務表現足以作典範時，最自然用 exemplary。
popular = 服務紀錄不等於受歡迎。

exercises.original: The hospital received praise for its admirable standards of patient care.
exercises.zh: 醫院因堪作榜樣的病人照護標準而獲讚賞。
exercises.upgrade: exemplary · 堪作榜樣的；模範的

options.explanation: respectful = 照護可以 respectful，但 standards 的整體高度更適合 exemplary。
exemplary = standards of care 高到值得其他機構效法，exemplary 很自然。
successful = 不表示標準值得模仿。

words.note: 當 admirable 指動機、行為、犧牲或品格具有無私、道德高尚的特質時可用；不是所有值得稱讚的事情都能稱 noble。
words.example: Giving up the prize to help the injured competitor was a noble gesture.
words.exampleZh: 把獎項讓出來幫助受傷對手，是一個高尚的舉動。

exercises.original: Giving up his seat to the injured passenger was admirable.
exercises.zh: 他把座位讓給受傷乘客，是一個高尚的舉動。
exercises.upgrade: noble · 高尚的；崇高的

options.explanation: successful = 讓座不是成功／失敗問題。
noble = 無私幫助有需要的人具有道德高尚感，noble 很自然。

exercises.original: Her decision to donate the prize money was admirable.
exercises.zh: 她決定捐出獎金，這個決定很高尚。
exercises.upgrade: noble · 高尚的；崇高的

options.explanation: excellent = 可以正面評價，但 noble 更強調無私動機。
noble = 捐出自己所得、具有無私意味時，noble 很貼切。

exercises.original: He made an admirable sacrifice to protect the rest of the team.
exercises.zh: 他為保護團隊其他人作出了高尚的犧牲。
exercises.upgrade: noble · 高尚的；崇高的

options.explanation: successful = 犧牲是否成功不是主要評價。
pleasant = sacrifice 通常並不 pleasant。
noble = noble sacrifice 是自然搭配，強調無私和道德高度。

words.meaning: 值得肯定的；表現可嘉的
words.note: 較正式，常形容成績、表現、努力或成果在當時條件下值得認可，即使未必達到非常出色的程度。
words.example: Finishing the race in those conditions was a creditable achievement.
words.exampleZh: 在那種情況下完成比賽，是一項值得肯定的成就。

exercises.original: Finishing the project on time despite the staff shortage was admirable.
exercises.zh: 在人手不足下仍準時完成項目，是值得肯定的表現。
exercises.upgrade: creditable · 值得肯定的；表現可嘉的

options.explanation: popular = 是否受歡迎不重要。
creditable = despite the staff shortage 強調條件不利，因此成果可稱 creditable。
successful = 確實成功完成，但 creditable 更表示在困難條件下值得肯定。

exercises.original: Her exam result was admirable given how little time she had to prepare.
exercises.zh: 考慮到她準備時間很少，這個考試成績值得肯定。
exercises.upgrade: creditable · 值得肯定的；表現可嘉的

options.explanation: excellent = 成績未必頂尖；重點是在有限準備下仍值得肯定。
creditable = given how little time 是典型條件性正面評價，最適合 creditable。

exercises.original: The team produced an admirable performance despite losing two key players.
exercises.zh: 儘管失去兩名主力，球隊仍有值得肯定的表現。
exercises.upgrade: creditable · 值得肯定的；表現可嘉的

options.explanation: successful = 球隊未必贏了比賽。
creditable = 在不利條件下仍交出不錯表現，creditable performance 很自然。
attractive = 可能踢得好看，但不是這裡的評價核心。

words.meaning: 令人印象深刻的；令人佩服的
words.note: 當 admirable 指能力、成就、毅力或表現令人佩服、印象深刻時可用；比 admirable 更偏結果帶來的強烈印象，不一定涉及道德評價。
words.example: Her ability to remain calm under pressure was impressive.
words.exampleZh: 她在壓力下仍能保持冷靜，令人佩服。

exercises.original: Her ability to remain calm during the crisis was admirable.
exercises.zh: 她在危機中保持冷靜的能力令人佩服。
exercises.upgrade: impressive · 令人印象深刻的；令人佩服的

options.explanation: pleasant = 危機情境不涉及舒適感。
impressive = 在高壓情況下展現出非凡能力，impressive 很自然。
successful = 能力本身不是成功結果。

exercises.original: The amount of research behind the report is admirable.
exercises.zh: 這份報告背後投入的研究量令人印象深刻。
exercises.upgrade: impressive · 令人印象深刻的；令人佩服的

options.explanation: impressive = 令人佩服的是規模和投入程度，impressive 比道德性的詞更精確。
successful = 研究量大不等於成功。

exercises.original: His progress in such a short time is admirable.
exercises.zh: 他在這麼短時間內取得的進步令人印象深刻。
exercises.upgrade: impressive · 令人印象深刻的；令人佩服的

options.explanation: successful = progress 可以成功，但 impressive 更直接評價其程度。
impressive = in such a short time 強調成果程度令人佩服，因此 impressive 最貼切。

falseSynonyms.zh: 受歡迎不等於 admirable popular 表示很多人喜歡；某人或某事可以很受歡迎，但未必值得尊敬或讚揚。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Popular means widely liked; admirable means worthy of respect or praise.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成功不等於 admirable successful 表示達成目標；成功的方法或結果未必具有值得敬佩的品質。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Successful means achieving a goal; admirable means deserving respect or praise.

falseSynonyms.zh: 著名不等於 admirable famous 只表示很多人知道；知名度本身不代表值得欣賞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Famous concerns recognition; admirable concerns merit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人愉快不等於 admirable pleasant 表示令人舒服或愉快；它不表示道德、努力或成就值得尊敬。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pleasant describes enjoyment; admirable describes merit or respectworthiness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有吸引力不等於 admirable attractive 常指外表、設計或特質具有吸引力；admirable 更重視值得敬佩或稱讚。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Attractive means appealing; admirable means deserving admiration.

falseSynonyms.zh: 優秀不完全等於 admirable excellent 表示品質非常高；admirable 更常帶『令人敬佩／值得讚賞』的價值判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Excellent describes high quality; admirable adds the idea of respect or approval.

falseSynonyms.zh: 表示尊重不等於值得尊敬 respectful 形容某人對別人表現出尊重；admirable 則表示某人或某事本身值得尊敬。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Respectful means showing respect; admirable means deserving respect.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞與形容詞不同 admire 是動詞，表示欽佩；admirable 是形容詞，表示值得欽佩的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We admire her courage. Her courage is admirable.
